newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 30.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Egyptian president to call for a summit of four Arab countries after meeting the Syrian president.
- Turkish officials threaten to use force against Iran and Syria.
- Riyad Bank posts $63 million net profit in the first quarter of 1997 and will pay dividends worth 600 million riyals to shareholders.
- Banks' assets in Jordan exceeded $8 billion in 1995.
- Saudi Basic Industries Corp's net profit for the first three months of 1997 exceeds one billion riyals.
- Morocco to offer government projects to the private sector.
- Sudan's police arrests a foreigner for openingfire in the capital.
- New changes in the Iraqi defence ministry might include the minister.
